jsesh.mdc.model
Class ModelElement

java.lang.Object
  java.util.Observable
      jsesh.mdc.model.ModelElement
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.lang.Comparable, java.util.Observer
Direct Known Subclasses:
BasicItemList, HBox, InnerGroup, Modifier, ModifiersList, TopItem, TopItemList
public abstract class ModelElement
extends java.util.Observable
implements java.util.Observer, java.lang.Comparable

Model Element is the parent class of all Manuel de Codage constructs. Each model element is potentially a container for other elements, and modifications to the lower levels are forwarded to the upper levels (hence each element is potentially an observer for its sub-elements).

Model elements are comparable one to each other. The way this is done is :

  1. if the elements belong to different classes, we compare the names of the classes.
  2. if the objects belong to the exact same class, then the definition depends on the class itself.
To ensure that all classes implement compareTo, ModelElement doesn't provide any implementation. Instead, it provides a number of protected helpful functions : IMPORTANT : The current system does not ensure views are systematically deleted. IMPROVE IT. compareContents

protected final int compareContents(ModelElement e)
Compare the contents of two model elements. Usable to implement compareToAux. In fact, when this and e have the same type and are completely defined by their sub elements (i.e. in practice, have no other field than their children), compareToAux is simply a call to this method.

Parameters:
e - : a model element, of the exact same type as this.
Returns:
an int, < 0 if this < e, 0 if this and e have the same content; and > 0 if this > e.
See Also:
compareToAux
